plugin.name: Python
plugin.description: Python interpreters, virtual environments, dependency installation (uv / Poetry / PDM / Pipenv / conda / pip) and script runs
opt.script.info: A .py file relative to the module directory. Use either Script or Module.
opt.module.info: Module run with python -m, such as package.cli. Write package.cli:main to call that function, like a [project.scripts] entry point.
opt.envFile.info: .env file loaded before start, relative to the module directory; leave empty to skip. Variables set in the run configuration take precedence.
info.installPackage: Separate multiple packages with spaces; version specifiers are allowed. Installed into the project virtual environment without changing dependency files.
